enabled.description: Whether the Kafka prerequisite should be installed.

nameOverride.description: String to partially override fullname (will maintain the release name).

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override the generated release name.

namespace.description: The namespace in which to deploy OpenSearch. If not set, defaults to the release namespace.

topics.description: Kafka topics to create on the cluster.

storageCapacity.description: The storage capacity to apply to the PVC that will be created for the Kafka cluster.

existingUserPwdSecretName.description: The name of an existing secret containing the Kafka pipeline, smart-cache and (if enabled) external passwords.

pipelinePassword.description: The `pipeline` user password to apply to the Kafka cluster.

smartCachePassword.description: The `smart-cache` user password to apply to the Kafka cluster.

externalPassword.description: The `external` user password to apply to the Kafka cluster.

enabled.description: Whether external access to Kafka is enabled.

bootstrapHost.description: The external bootstrap hostname/IP. Required if `externalAccess.enabled` is `true`.

bootstrapNodePort.description: The bootstrap NodePort. Must be in range 30000-32767.

brokerNodePort.description: The broker NodePort. Must be different from bootstrap nodeport, range 30000-32767.

tls.description: Whether TLS is enabled for the external listener.
